detail.longDescription: ⚙️ Event-driven runtime: the server accepts pipeline and run requests, a control plane schedules and dispatches work, workers execute runs. # PostgreSQL stores durable state, # NATS JetStream carries lifecycle events 🚀 Install via curl script, # Homebrew or prebuilt Linux/macOS binaries. Production runs on # Kubernetes with # Helm , or one-click deploys on # Railway , # Render and # DigitalOcean (standalone image with # SQLite )
